verdict.rationale: ClickUp documents a first-party MCP server on its developer site that lets external AI agents work with Workspace data such as tasks, lists, folders and docs. The docs include a Claude setup guide, an MCP tools reference (e.g. Search Workspace) and use cases such as time tracking and reports, and a probe confirmed the official MCP documentation page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration that connecting an agent works as documented.
